summary: Q = ∫ Σ_x v*Rv over l (pointwise ≥ 0 since R ≥ 0), so Q ≥ 0 and Re Q is its integral; push the stack measure forward by the orbit point and compare with the infimum defining the energy.

steps.claim: W_Z measurable; v*Rv ≥ 0 for every v (R positive semidefinite); integrability of the topKernel integrands.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨_, r, _⟩ := (isCut_besselVector Z).stronglyMeasurable, hR.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg, by
    simpa using (floorForm_top_eq_integral Z · · 0 |>.1.restrict (s := ·))

steps.typed_fact:
∑ p, ∑ q, R p q * ⟪v p, v q⟫_ℂ = ∑ x,
    star (v · x) ⬝ᵥ R *ᵥ (v · x)

steps.claim: Write Q as one integral of the sum.
steps.lean: simp (disch := fun_prop) only [topKernel, ht, ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_finsetSum]

steps.claim: Q ≥ 0; Re Q = ∫ ofReal(…) ; push forward by the orbit point (measurePreserving_orbitPoint), restrict to the indicator, and decompose the stack measure at the top.
steps.lean:
grw (transparency := default) [and_iff_right (integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ p), ← RCLike.re_to_complex,
    ← integral_re, ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (.re ?_) (.of_forall fun _ ↦ p.1),
    ← (measurePreserving_orbitPoint ..).2, lintegral_map_le, ← lintegral_indicator_le,
    stackMeasure_top, lintegral_mconv_symm (.indicator ?_ (o.preimage_of_continuous
    ?_).measurableSet)] <;> try fun_prop [frameGram, correlation, besselCorrelation]

steps.claim: For a.e. x of the floor measure: the indicator condition and the energy (an infimum) is ≤ the integral at l = x,
steps.lean:
refine lintegral_le_of_ae_imp ae_floorMeasure_mem fun x a ↦ indicator_apply_le' (fun k ↦
    iInf₂_le_of_le x ⟨a, rfl⟩ (lintegral_le_of_ae_imp F.measureH_spec.1 fun y s ↦ ?_)) (by simp)

steps.claim: the condition matches (frame Gram diagonal invariance),
steps.lean:
rw [indicator_of_mem
    (by rw [Set.mem_preimage, ← (frameGram_diag_mul (unitriGroup_inf_floorGroup_last.ge s)
    _).2]; simpa [orbitPoint, -besselFrame_last] using! k), e]

steps.claim: and the sum of nonnegative reals.
